changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Create backup table for concept_name preferred flags before CIEL re-import
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healthmesh_concept_name_preferred_backup ( backup_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, concept_name_id INT NOT NULL, concept_id INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(255), locale VARCHAR(50), locale_preferred BOOLEAN, concept_name_type VARCHAR(50), voided BOOLEAN, uuid CHAR(38), backed_up_at DATETIME NOT NULL, backup_reason VARCHAR(255), UNIQUE KEY hm_cn_pref_backup_once (concept_name_id, backup_reason) );

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Backup current preferred concept names before normalizing locale_preferred flags
changeSet.sql: INSERT IGNORE INTO healthmesh_concept_name_preferred_backup ( concept_name_id, concept_id, name, locale, locale_preferred, concept_name_type, voided, uuid, backed_up_at, backup_reason ) SELECT cn.concept_name_id, cn.concept_id, cn.name, cn.locale, cn.locale_preferred, cn.concept_name_type, cn.voided, cn.uuid, NOW(), 'Before CIEL preferred-name preimport normalization 20260609' FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.voided = FALSE AND cn.locale_preferred = TRUE;

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Clear existing Spanish preferred names for the CIEL concepts that have failed during OCL import with: "Sólo un nombre preferido está permitido para cada configuración regional". This is intentionally explicit and traceable from the import logs, including repeated and historical failures.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id SET cn.locale_preferred = 0 WHERE c.uuid IN ( '162977AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '159589AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '157618AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '157615AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '157607AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '157634AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '1198AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '156225AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '111089AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', '1034AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA' ) AND cn.locale = 'es' AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale_preferred = 1;

changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Clear existing Spanish preferred names for CIEL-style concepts before importing CIEL. This lets the Spanish preferred name coming from CIEL/OCL become the canonical preferred name.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept_name cn JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = cn.concept_id SET cn.locale_preferred = FALSE WHERE c.uuid REGEXP '^[0-9]+A{20,}$' AND cn.locale = 'es' AND cn.voided = FALSE AND cn.locale_preferred = TRUE;

changeSet.author: HealthMesh

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT concept_id, locale FROM concept_name WHERE voided = FALSE AND locale_preferred = TRUE GROUP BY concept_id, locale HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicated_preferred_names

changeSet.comment: Stop startup if duplicate preferred names by locale remain before CIEL import
changeSet.sql: SELECT 'OK: no duplicate preferred concept names by locale before CIEL import' AS healthmesh_ciel_preimport_check;
